purpose: Fresh independent larger matched-law comparison; no predetermined outcome

analysis.resampling: Whole environment vectors; pool batches within size/model/domain; independent groups
analysis.control_test: Predeclared maximum absolute standardized curvature contrast over both deterministic models and all three windows
analysis.interpretation: Finite-window contrast only; no absence/equivalence claim from non-rejection; control test is a diagnostic and never an exclusion rule

completion: All batches and pairs required; preserve interrupted attempts; exact seed replay only; no replacement or sign-based extension; earlier cohorts and pilots excluded
